name: memory_read
description:
Read memory entries from MEMORY.md.

Use this to recall facts, preferences, decisions, or references saved in previous sessions before answering or acting. Memory is also injected automatically at session start — use memory_read mid-session when you need to drill into a specific entry or check whether something was saved.

SCOPE

- global: reads .projectflows/agents/MEMORY.md (shared across all agents)
- local: reads .projectflows/agents/<this-agent>/MEMORY.md (this agent only)
- both: reads and returns both files merged (default)

If name is provided, only that entry is returned. Otherwise all entries in scope are returned.

FORMAT

Entries are returned in their full stored format:

---
name: <name>
description: <description>
type: <type>
---
<content>

scope.description: Which MEMORY.md to read. Defaults to both.

name.description: Read a specific entry by name. Omit to read all entries in scope.
